input_quality.description: Required. How well the deck could actually be read. 'good' = every slide rendered and legible; 'image_only' = slides are images with no extractable text; 'partial' = some slides unread. Required rather than optional because its ABSENCE used to be indistinguishable from 'good', so a review of a deck nobody could read looked identical to a review of one that was read.

claimed_stage.description: Stage the deck itself states, as a stage token (pre_seed, seed, series_a, series_b, growth). Omit or set null when the deck never states a stage — do not invent a descriptive value.

ai_company_status.description: Deterministic AI classification: 'ai_core' if AI/ML is genuinely core to the product with evidence; 'ai_claimed_unverified' if the deck claims AI but no core-AI signals are present; 'not_ai' if no AI claim and not AI.

ai_evidence.description: Evidence or claim found for AI classification. Recommended when ai_company_status is not 'not_ai'.

visual_evidence_captured.description: Did the reviewer actually SEE this slide rendered, as opposed to reading text extracted from it? Design criteria are scored from what a reader sees; a slide that was never rendered cannot support that judgement.
